title: Sparkly lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff6b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0'>
    <path d='M14 22 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M86 18 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M80 62 l1.3 3.5 3.5 1.3 -3.5 1.3 -1.3 3.5 -1.3 -3.5 -3.5 -1.3 3.5 -1.3z'/>
    <path d='M20 66 l1 2.8 2.8 1 -2.8 1 -1 2.8 -1 -2.8 -2.8 -1 2.8 -1z'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='18' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='44' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='46' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='14' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='1.3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- light beam -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='16' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- base / ground -->
  <rect x='28' y='86' width='44' height='7' rx='2' fill='#8a6b4f'/>
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='36' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8846a'/>
  <!-- tower -->
  <path d='M38 82 L42 40 L58 40 L62 82 Z' fill='#f2f2f5'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <path d='M41 70 L59 70 L59 62 L41 62 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M42 52 L58 52 L58 44 L42 44 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- stripe shading edges -->
  <path d='M41 62 L59 62 L59 59.5 L41 59.5 Z' fill='#c9352e'/>
  <path d='M42 44 L58 44 L58 41.5 L42 41.5 Z' fill='#c9352e'/>
  <!-- gallery -->
  <rect x='34' y='36' width='32' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <!-- lamp room -->
  <rect x='40' y='24' width='20' height='13' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='40' y='24' width='20' height='13' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <path d='M38 24 L50 12 L62 24 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M50 12 L50 12 L62 24 L56 24 Z' fill='#c9352e'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='72' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='77' r='1' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
